risks.risk: Disc inclusion and working condition are unknown (could be missing discs, scratched, or not playable).
risks.proof: A clear video/clip showing each disc (front/back) removed from its case, plus a quick console test or proof-of-play (e.g., loading screen) for at least one title.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: discs may be missing or not working (as not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Region lock / wrong platform mismatch (PS4 vs PS5 vs 4PS/PS5 confusion).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the exact game title and the PS4/PS5 compatibility text on the back/label for each item (or a screenshot of the disc label showing platform/region).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: compatibility uncertain (as potentially wrong platform).

risks.risk: Incomplete packaging (missing manuals/inserts) or damaged cases.
risks.proof: Photos of the full contents of one complete box set (case + inserts/manuals) and a close-up of case condition (cracks, broken hinges).

risks.risk: Title list may be inaccurate or partially unreadable (some labels not fully readable).
risks.proof: A straight-on photo of every box front with the title fully readable, or a spreadsheet/list from the seller matching the photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: unknown exact titles/count (assume fewer usable items).

risks.risk: Storage/handling issues (humidity/warping) affecting discs or cases.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of disc surfaces for haze/scratches and case interior for moisture damage; optionally a quick wipe test showing no residue.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: possible storage wear.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of each box front/back showing the exact title and whether it is PS4 or PS5 compatible (and region if shown).
Show whether discs are included: open one case and photograph the disc(s) clearly (front/back).
Provide a short video clip of at least one disc being inserted and loading on the correct console (or a proof-of-play screenshot).
Show the full contents of one complete package (case + manual/inserts) and confirm if any are missing.
Confirm the exact number of games and list the titles that are fully readable from the boxes.
response.reason: The witness report identifies boxed PlayStation game items with visible PS5/4PS markings and specific label text, so the item type can be priced. However, disc working condition, exact platform, and completeness are not verifiable from the report, so it should be priced at the worst-case assumption until proof is provided.
